rule: An unresolved or unsupported item is evidence, not permission to infer a replacement.

items.evidence: Xead has 227 Functions and Xeaf has 203; identity-set comparison leaves 47 Xead-only and 23 Xeaf-only entries
items.risk: one-to-one conversion would silently lose design-only meaning or promote helper/runtime functions
items.stopCondition: do not accept a Function mapping without explicit reconciliation evidence

items.evidence: TaskFunctionIO addresses Panel/Spool while legacy CRUD projection aggregates Function-level IOTable operations
items.risk: potential Function access may be reported as the effect of one Business Action
items.stopCondition: derive action-specific CRUD only from an accepted path-specific operation relation

items.evidence: 21 of 80 Relationships carry conditional existence prose
items.risk: condition may be dropped or natural language may be compiled as deterministic truth
items.stopCondition: preserve source condition as proposal/unresolved until accepted Validation/Lifecycle semantics exist

items.evidence: 52 Xead fields are DERIVABLE; 51 structurally correspond to Xeaf VIRTUAL fields, but calculation authority can be distributed across Script/TypeOptions/runtime logic
items.risk: DERIVABLE/VIRTUAL labels may be treated as complete semantic formulas
items.stopCondition: separate semantic derived-value contract from evaluator/realization and retain missing formula authority

items.evidence: 35 of 148 TaskAction elements have no ID
items.risk: SortKey, indentation, or XML order may become accidental durable identity
items.stopCondition: use exact-snapshot source locator; introduce durable step identity only from repeated traceability pressure

items.evidence: TaskFunctionIO.Operations contains target-specific UI instructions
items.risk: business procedure becomes tied to legacy GUI interaction
items.stopCondition: separate Business Action, Function/Capability use, and Target interaction instruction

items.evidence: native Script can validate, derive, mutate tables, and alter presentation state
items.risk: declared CRUD or static analysis may understate actual effect, while code extraction may over-promote implementation to semantics
items.stopCondition: preserve native code and require actual or accepted effect evidence before semantic attribution

items.evidence: Xeaf System binds user/session/numbering/calendar/tax/exchange-rate and other service roles to physical table IDs
items.risk: reference-specific physical tables become Core platform semantics
items.stopCondition: express reusable service contracts through Plugin-defined Capability/Extension contracts and explicit bindings

items.evidence: current Runtime Plugin CapabilityKind is a closed Core enum and has no source-adapter/tool contract
items.risk: adding the adapter requires Core enum growth or misuse of an unrelated Capability kind
items.stopCondition: reader/reference work may proceed, but production Plugin registration must not add a one-off Core CapabilityKind

items.evidence: Reference Model carries redistribution/use conditions distinct from BSD-licensed Xead source repositories
items.risk: test fixtures or mapping artifacts may republish protected model content without a confirmed boundary
items.stopCondition: keep original model contents outside public repository until usage/republication boundary is confirmed

items.evidence: XeadModeler preserves ordered multi-field TableKey/TableKeyField sets and PK/FK/SK/XK distinctions; Relationship refers to key identities on both sides
items.risk: database-oriented source key assertions can be silently promoted to business occurrence identity, candidate key, or functional dependency
items.stopCondition: preserve source key kind, membership, relation references and provenance; keep business identifier/candidate key/FD unresolved until separately accepted or corroborated

items.evidence: XeadDriver XF290/XF390 use Function/Detail KeyFields when declared and fall back to Table PK only when the override is absent
items.risk: record-selection requirements of one interaction can become durable Data identity or leak target/runtime assumptions into semantics
items.stopCondition: preserve declared KeyFields as Function/Interaction source facts distinct from Table key, business identity, Canonical identity and physical key authority

items.evidence: a composite set of values may represent an allowed-combination/domain restriction independently of whether dependent attributes are present
items.risk: transfer can collapse allowed-combination semantics into identity/FD or omit the constraint entirely
items.stopCondition: do not infer domain restriction from key shape alone; when source or accepted design establishes it, preserve it separately from business identity and functional dependency

items.evidence: the benchmark contains 52 DERIVABLE fields and 51 structural Xeaf VIRTUAL correspondences, while public X-TEA modeling guidance also uses derived attributes as relation keys; exact benchmark participation in Relationship keys is not yet established
items.risk: a derived relation can disappear from the logical model, or native evaluator code can be mistaken for the semantic relation itself
items.stopCondition: confirm exact source participation before claiming a dynamic reference; if present, preserve derivation semantics, evaluator/native realization and Relation as separate traceable layers

items.evidence: some legacy meaning may only be recoverable by combining XML structure, runtime code, prose and observed behavior rather than by one explicit authoritative declaration
items.risk: AI or importer synthesis may be reported as source truth merely because the reconstructed graph is internally coherent
items.stopCondition: record exact source observations and inference provenance; keep reconstructed meaning as proposal/unresolved until Shared Acceptance creates or updates authoritative Source

items.evidence: legacy/imported schemas can retain identifier-like fields even when the transfer contract has not established their uniqueness scope, temporal validity, relation role, or external authority
items.risk: an importer or AI can claim business identity preservation from field presence and value migration alone
items.stopCondition: do not classify identifier-like fields as accepted business identity or candidate key until uniqueness scope, temporal conditions, Source/Contract responsibility and Relation/Constraint evidence are explicit

items.evidence: XeadModeler sorts TableKeyField by SortKey and uses TableField DataTypeID while matching relationship fields; XML source order alone does not define the correspondence
items.risk: equal-arity composite keys can be paired incorrectly or a type-incompatible relationship can be accepted during transfer
items.stopCondition: for multi-field relationship keys, require unambiguous SortKey ordering before positional comparison; preserve missing/duplicate SortKey and explicit DataTypeID mismatch as unresolved and do not repair by field name or source order

items.evidence: RMT can increasingly reconstruct legacy schema, key topology, function interaction and runtime constraints with high fidelity
items.risk: better observation can silently become stronger pressure to preserve accidental As-Is structure in the TEI target design
items.stopCondition: keep exact source observations as Source/Actual Evidence and require an explicit Proposal/Acceptance step before any reconstructed legacy structure becomes Desired or authoritative TEI meaning

items.evidence: Xead Table, TableField, TableKey and Relationship identities can be absent or duplicated in malformed, merged, or hand-edited source; lookup-based processing can otherwise miss isolated absent IDs or retain one apparent resolution after overwrite
items.risk: invalid source identity can go unnoticed until referenced, or a key/Relationship can be attributed to an arbitrary duplicate occurrence and reported as resolved
items.stopCondition: diagnose missing/duplicate Xead Table, Field, TableKey and Relationship identities from source facts, suppress ambiguous lookup/metadata selection, and keep dependent meaning unresolved until source identity is explicit and unambiguous

items.evidence: the inspection layer preserves source facts for audit even when relational diagnostics remain; aggregate fact counts therefore include observations that are not structurally ready for deterministic lowering
items.risk: later transcription can accidentally consume an unresolved fact because it exists in RelationalFacts, bypassing the diagnostic boundary
items.stopCondition: expose relationalResolutionStatus independently from fact availability and require resolved status before deterministic semantic lowering; unresolved facts remain Source Evidence only

items.evidence: legacy models may encode effective-start dates, history numbers, version selectors, or latest flags alongside keys even when those values identify a version/current view rather than the underlying business occurrence
items.risk: transfer can make version identity part of business occurrence identity, hide stable relations, or infer temporal semantics from field names and physical key shape
items.stopCondition: separate occurrence identity from history/version identity and validity semantics; do not promote effective-date/history/latest fields from source shape alone, and do not require a history model without business temporal evidence

items.evidence: relational inspection originally exposed one global resolved/unresolved status; in a large source, one invalid Key or identity diagnostic can coexist with unrelated structurally valid facts, while declared Function/Detail KeyFields are not yet validated strongly enough for deterministic lowering
items.risk: transcription becomes all-or-nothing, or a consumer bypasses the global unresolved status and accidentally consumes unresolved facts without dependency-aware checks
items.stopCondition: publish per-fact resolved/unresolved/unvalidated readiness separately from source facts and global status, propagate dependent diagnostics, keep raw unresolved facts as Evidence, and require explicit local resolved readiness before any partial deterministic lowering
